description: This file defines the SnapshotStorage class, which manages frame snapshots, resource snapshots, and rendering for trace analysis in a web automation context. It includes methods for adding resources, frame snapshots, retrieving snapshots by name, finalizing data, and checking resource overrides.

classes.name: SnapshotStorage
classes.description: Manages storage and retrieval of frame and resource snapshots, including caching and override handling.

methods.name: addResource
methods.description: Adds a resource snapshot to a specific context, rewriting its URL.

methods.name: addFrameSnapshot
methods.description: Adds a frame snapshot and creates a corresponding renderer, associating it with a context.

methods.name: snapshotByName
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot renderer by its name within a given page or frame ID.

methods.name: snapshotsForTest
methods.description: Returns all keys (IDs) of stored frame snapshots for testing purposes.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Sorts resources and identifies URLs with resource overrides to prevent stale caching.

methods.name: hasResourceOverride
methods.description: Checks if a given URL has resource overrides.

methods.name: _ensureResourcesForContext
methods.description: Ensures and retrieves the resource list for a specific context ID.
